pick_word.subtitle: Work together! Make sure the guys...

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
How often do you get in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, guys... Push on one... Two... Three!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ungh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great! We moved it! Now let's go again... One... Two... Three!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ungh!
And so, twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We did it! We got it to the other side!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See, that... That wasn't so bad...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess... But it doesn't change anything!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Well done, new fish, well done. You just might make it here yet.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: It turns out that Officer Monte happens to have a date scheduled for tonight! That means he's going to be out of his office for the evening!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: One of the guards let slip that Monte's office has a secret exit... It's an evacuation tunnel he built in case the French ever invaded!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The French?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Don't ask. The tricky part is getting into his office. We're going to have to get fake IDs just to get into the administrative building...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: And we're going to have to pickpocket the key off Monte's belt to get into the office!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This sounds impossible!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: I'm not done talking. Even if we escape, we're still in the middle of nowhere! It's two days walk back to Centerscore, and that means we'll have to steal food from the cafeteria!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How are we supposed to do all that today? It's almost night-time!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Yep... And that means we've got one whole round of manual labor before it's too late!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: The three of you should split up! One of you should volunteer to do kitchen duty and get the supplies...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think I can handle that...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: One of you should volunteer to work down by the lake and grab Monte's office keys...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm on that..

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: And one of you should pretend to be sick and get sent to the nurse's office!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's in the nurse's office?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: The medical IDs that we'll need to get into the admin building, of course! We just swipe them in the scanners, and the main doors will open!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll handle that. I'm mad good with nurses.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Heh. I like your style.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hmm... You know, I think we can pull this off! But what are you going to be doing this whole time, Max?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Don't worry about me, new fish. Let's just say I'll be setting up a distraction to cover our escape...
The guys split up to complete their tasks! Who do you want to play as first?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Yeah! That's the spirit!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I dunno... What if we get in more trouble? We'll have to stay here even longer!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: That's what I thought too. I was only sentenced here for three months. Then Monte extended my sentence for bad behavior. Then he extended it again. And again.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, was your behavior bad?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: That's not the point! If you boys want to see your lovely ladies again, you're gonna have to bust out of here... And you're not gonna get a better shot at it than tonight.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Think of it this way, Brendan. If we escape, we can go back and get the evidence we need to clear our names! They won't send us back here if we're innocent!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I guess you're right. I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, heck, I'm in! I've wanted to break out of here from the minute I heard it wasn't co-ed!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: All right, team! Here's the plan!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Max, but there's no way I'm taking that risk. What if we get caught? Then they'll just add more time to our sentence!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! Who made you our leader? `I'm` totally down to bust out of this joint!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! Who made you our leader? [i]I'm[/i] totally down to bust out of this joint!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you serious? You can't just deal with it for 3 months? You're risking your whole future!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm going crazy here, dogg! I haven't seen a girl in a week! I need ladies in my life, man! I need them like I need air!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now you're just exaggerating!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Exaggerating? Just last night I was thinking Brendan might look pretty good in a blonde wig!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why blonde?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Hey! Why don't you guys stop bickering like old ladies at the fish market and hear me out?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Two years ago, I was only sentenced here for three months. Then Monte extended my sentence for bad behavior. Then he extended it again. And again.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: One thing I've realized is, there's only two ways out of here. In a coffin or out the back door... And the coffin salesman isn't coming by for another year!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know what that means, but it sounds scary! Count me in, Max!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, wait, if both of you want to escape, I guess I'll do it too... I don't want to be left here alone...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe you should've thought of that before speaking for all of us!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Enough! Now, here's the plan...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, wait, let's just do this logically. We'll take turns pushing the boulder so none of us get too tired! Hector, go first!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why do I have to go first? You're the football player! You do it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: See? There you go again! Always trying to shove the responsibility onto someone else!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh, we don't have time for this! Brendan, you push!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can't push it by myself! Being a Warchief requires exceptionally nimble fingers kept in peak condition! What if I get hurt?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, so you're getting on my case about not helping, but you won't volunteer yourself? You've got a lot of nerve...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Shut up, all of you! You keep arguing like that, and you won't last one week! Let me show you how it's done...
Max shoves the three guys back and squares up against the boulder.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Ungh... Bunch of cry-babies... Ungh!
A while later, Max has single-handedly pushed the boulder all the way across the field.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: There! Done!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen, man, you really didn't have to do that...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: I didn't do it for you. I did it to prove a point. In here, you don't get anything done by talking or fighting about it.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: If you want something accomplished, you gotta put your shoulder to the stone... Literally! You got that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I really hope we do...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You see, boys, there is a crisis of masculinity in this country! All over our fine nation, a whole generation of young men are growing up to be spineless, yellow-bellied wimps!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, like our greatest leader said, the truck stops here! I, Officer Monte Carlos Monte, am going to turn you worthless lot into `men!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, like our greatest leader said, the truck stops here! I, Officer Monte Carlos Monte, am going to turn you worthless lot into [i]men![/i]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Is this legal?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: For the next three months, the only thing you boys will know is this camp. The outside world does not exist! No phone calls! No TV! And none of that fancy electronified mail!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... What if our girlfriends write us letters?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Then I'll open them and read them out loud in a mocking voice! Now that we've got that settled, let's discuss your schedules!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: From nine to ten, manual labor! Then from ten to eleven, manual labor! From eleven to twelve, more manual labor! And at twelve... Lunch!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, lunch doesn't sound that bad...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh, wasn't I clear? `I'm` eating lunch! You guys are doing more manual labor! Do you want to hear the rest of your schedules?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, wasn't I clear? [i]I'm[/i] eating lunch! You guys are doing more manual labor! Do you want to hear the rest of your schedules?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think we get the gist...
And so a few minutes later, in a forest clearing, the three guys crowd around a big heavy boulder...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We've got two hours to push this boulder all the way to the other side of this field? Seriously? What would that even accomplish?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know how to push a boulder! I can't push a boulder! I don't think I've ever even `seen` a boulder!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know how to push a boulder! I can't push a boulder! I don't think I've ever even [i]seen[/i] a boulder!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, let's just focus, okay? Monte said he wouldn't be back for an hour, so maybe if we get it done, we can relax...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh yeah? I've got a better idea! Why don't `you` push it, Hector, since you're the whole reason we're in this mess?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah? I've got a better idea! Why don't [i]you[/i] push it, Hector, since you're the whole reason we're in this mess?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, I'll admit I kind of messed up, but you are starting to seriously tick me off...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Hey! New fish! You want to find out how to push that boulder, or are you just gonna stand around bickering all day?
A tall, tough-looking kid strolls up from out of the bushes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I know you! You're Jacob's older brother! You got sent to boot camp two years ago!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: The name's Max, new fish, and it was one year, nine months, and ten days ago. Around here, you learn to keep track of time real fast.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Normally, I'd let you learn it the hard way... But you were good to my brother, if I recall, so I'm going to give you three a little tip.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: If you want a free minute to yourselves, you're gonna want to start pushing that boulder.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But how are we supposed to do that? It's huge!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: You'd be amazed what three strong guys can do with a little coordination. If the three of you work together and don't bicker, you'll get it done in no time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You hear that, you two? We're going to have to work together if we're gonna do this! Come on!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... All right...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you say so...
The three guys lock shoulders and start pushing!

rounds.subtitle: Work together! Make sure the guys...
Work together! Make sure the guys...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ha! Yeah, right! You know who else claimed he was framed? The Count of Monte Cristo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He `was` framed!
nodes.text_bbcode: He [i]was[/i] framed!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Really? That's not how I interpreted the book...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sir, please, if you'll just hear us out, there's been a terrible misunderstanding... I assure you, we can explain everything... We are actually totally innocent...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Shut your trap, boy! I don't care one lick if you're innocent, guilty, or both! You know why? Because that kind of talk is for wimps!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Keep on blubbering, pal. You're going to have a long time to talk your fancy lawyer-talk when I slam you in Solitary Confinement!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well? Wanna talk some more about your innocence?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's what I thought.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The fact of the matter is, the great city of Centerscore has decided that you pathetic yellow-bellies need some good ol' fashioned rehabilitation... And I'm more than happy to oblige!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I beg your pardon? You dare to question my competence as an officer of the law?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure! You barely reviewed the evidence, didn't check our alibis, and you fell asleep when I tried to give you my testimony!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You know what, kid?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I like your style! You've got real guts, talking back to a cop like that! Big, thick, rubbery guts!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You remind me of myself when I was your age! Keep up the good work and maybe you and I can stay up late and watch scary movies!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's... Um... A really nice offer... But what I'm trying to say is, we don't deserve to be here! And if you just listen, we can prove our innocence!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh son, you think this is about right or wrong, guilty or innocent? Not at all! That's not why you three are here!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's not?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No! You're here because you're wimps!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The truth is... I was on a date with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You're dating Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes! No! I don't know, maybe? The point is, I got the fireworks because she loves them! I was going to set them off for her... But they were stolen from my van!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But the photo of your van...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda and I have to go on dates on the Wilson side of town... It's the only place we can go where we'll be sure no one will recognize us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But that's... That's a great alibi, and it explains the fireworks! Why didn't you tell the cops that in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, because... Because I didn't want the whole school to know about me and Amanda, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you kept that a secret... And let us get sentenced to boot camp... So it wouldn't hurt your reputation?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not about my reputation! I was trying to protect Amanda! People would totally trash-talk her if they knew she was cheating on Zach!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Typical Hector! Always putting girls ahead of his friends! You ruined my life to keep your hookup from having her feelings hurt!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is really not cool, Hector... Really not cool.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys, it's not like that, I swear! I've... I've never felt this way about a girl, okay? I'm doing this because I... Because I l...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, well, well, isn't this cute? A bunch of little old ladies sitting around in a sewing circle! How positively adorable!
The gate swings open, and Officer Monte strolls out!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Too bad I eat little old ladies for breakfast! Now stand up straight, you worthless bags of wimp-juice, and get in the gym!
The guys file into the compound's gym and line up neatly side-by-side.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ahem, ahem! Welcome to Officer Monte's Boot Camp for Troubled Boys! You three must be the delinquents that burned down the Wilson High library!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why are you talking like that? You're the cop that arrested us!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: When I look at you three, you know what I see? Pathetic lumps of wimpy dough! This camp, boys, is the furnace that will turn you into men! The `Man Furnace!`
nodes.text_bbcode: When I look at you three, you know what I see? Pathetic lumps of wimpy dough! This camp, boys, is the furnace that will turn you into men! The [i]Man Furnace![/i]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Could you please not say things like 'Man Furnace'?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Also, that bit earlier, about eating old ladies for breakfast? That was pretty weird too...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Shut up! Do you sugarpuffs even realize why you're here?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No? No one's brave enough to speak up? How about you in the front? Do you know why you're here?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... Uh... I think we're here because...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Thank you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Thank you![/i]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw man, now you're turning on me, Howard? Et tooth, Blu-Ray?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure that's not the expression... And not the point. This is a really serious situation, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you've got an explanation for your actions, we need to know it. If you don't tell us, we've got no choice but to think the worst!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, okay, fine. I give up. Maybe you're right. Maybe I... I do have some kind of responsibility to tell you guys...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, sure, of course `you'll` side with Hector! You were part of the prank war all along! I bet you helped him burn down the library!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, sure, of course [i]you'll[/i] side with Hector! You were part of the prank war all along! I bet you helped him burn down the library!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? That's ridiculous! We're all in this mess together, all right?! You have no good reason to accuse me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And you've got no good reason to defend Hector, unless you were helping him all along! How could you lie to me like this? I thought we were friends!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not lying to you, dude! I just don't think we should be attacking each other right now!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And you know what I don't think we should be doing? Lying about whether or not we burned down the Wilson Library!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ugh, shut up, both of you! I'll tell you the truth, okay?! Just stop fighting!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This is going to be good...
Work together! Make sure the guys...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: What? Seriously? All three of you failed? There's no way we can escape without that stuff!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's see here...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Dear Howard...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I hope this letter reaches you safely. I miss you so much. It's still so hard to believe you're going to be gone for three months...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And it's still so hard to believe that you would be stupid and reckless enough to burn down the Wilson library! What were you guys thinking?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw man... Even Linda thinks I'm guilty! I need to get out of here and clear my name!
Hector reads his letter...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Dear Hector...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I hope shoe camp is going well! I'm sooooo jealous! I wish I was allowed to just sit around, trying on fancy boots all day! That sounds like so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks so much for not telling everyone where you were that night. That was one of the nicest things that any guy has ever...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eeeeeeee! There's a baby squirrel outside my window! Maybe if I catch him, I can teach him to talk! Brb!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awww... She really is the best...
And Brendan reads his letter...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Dear Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: This is a very difficult letter for me to write. I hadn't planned on talking to you again so soon... But with you in boot camp, I just don't know when I'll get another chance.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You and I broke up on a really bad note, and I still feel so guilty about that. I should have been more honest with you, and I should never have kissed Spud!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: It's just... With those fancy pick-up moves that Hector taught him, Spud was irresistible!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait, what?! You taught Spud pick-up moves?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Well... The funny thing is... Yes?
Meanwhile... Outside...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What's going on around here? Why is the alarm going off? What's the meaning of this madness?

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: Look out, Monte! There's a bear on the loose!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Grrrrroooowwwwl!
Monte winds up and delivers a swift punch to the bear's face! It yelps and runs off!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Max...
Back in the office...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Please. Brendan, I can explain...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's there to explain?! You're the reason Kat cheated on me! You're the worst friend ever! You ruined everything that was good in my life!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I hate you! I hate you! `I hate you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate you! I hate you! [i]I hate you![/i]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, guys? You might want to see these...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh? Hey! That's a letter from Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And that's one from Kat! Why would Kat write me a letter?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks for finding these! We totally would've missed them!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem, guys... Now let's put them away and stay focused!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh come on, I gotta know what Amanda said! Can we just read them real fast while Max works?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, okay... But don't get distracted!
Howard hands Brendan and Hector their letters, and everyone starts reading...
Howard discretely slides the letters into his pockets when...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! What're you doing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, nothing! Nothing! Don't worry about it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You were stealing some papers from Monte's shelf! What are they, our personal files?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You, uh, don't want to read mine... I've got some pretty weird medical conditions...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let me see!
Brendan grabs the letter from Howard's hands, and Hector grabs it out of Brendan's!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What the... This is a letter to me from Amanda! And there's one for Brendan from Kat!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kat wrote me a letter?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why were you trying to hide these letters?! Were you going to read them on your own?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, wait a minute! What's your deal, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wasn't going to read them, you idiots! I was trying to keep us focused on the mission!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: `HEY!` Could the three of you `please` shut up?! I'm trying to work here!
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]HEY![/i] Could the three of you [i]please[/i] shut up?! I'm trying to work here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But they... They want to read these letters...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Then let them read! I don't care! Just shut up and stop distracting me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... Okay...
The three guys start reading their respective letters...
The guys hunker down behind some cars in the guard's parking lot and stare at the administrative building.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So Officer Monte is off on his date, leaving his office wide open... But the building is still surrounded by guards!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How are we supposed to get in?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Remember those distractions I was preparing? Let's just say you can catch a lot more bears with honey than vinegar...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure that's 'flies'...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Oh, `I'm` pretty sure it's bears...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [i]I'm[/i] pretty sure it's bears...

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaiiiiiiiiiiiiiieeeeeeee! There's a bear in the compound! Everybody run!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Grrrrrowwwwwwwl!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Now! Go! Go!
The guys sprint into the building...
And break into Officer Monte's office! Max slides away a bookshelf, revealing a hidden door!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Quick! Open it!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: He's got a padlock on the stupid thing! Give me a minute... I'll crack it open!
Meanwhile... In a car rapidly racing towards boot camp...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hmph! That's the last time I ever trust a woman I met on the demon-box! There's no way that bimbo had `any` martial arts experience! Worst date ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmph! That's the last time I ever trust a woman I met on the demon-box! There's no way that bimbo had [i]any[/i] martial arts experience! Worst date ever!

nodes.text: Back in the office...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hurry, Max! Get it open!
While Max frantically struggles with the lock, Howard notices some papers on Monte's shelf...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh? What are these? 'Dear Howard...'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! These are the letters from our girlfriends! There's one for me, one for Brendan, and one for Hector!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Shoot! Come on! Arrrgh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Should I tell the guys about these... Or should I hold onto them and keep focused on the mission?

nodes.prompt: Should I tell the guys about these...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Should I tell the guys about these...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No keys, guys. Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I, uh, didn't really get any food...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Sorry, guys... I didn't get the IDs...
That night just after dinner, the guys meet up in the gym...
You played a good game, new fish, real good... But not quite perfect! That means your bonus scene stays locked up in boot camp! Give it another shot!
Or try playing our Premium Content Mega Pack, Love Potion Fun Pack!
Take personality quizzes, answer romantic trivia questions, and even play match-maker for some of your favorite Centerscore Students!
Suddenly, the boys hear the sound of rapidly approaching footsteps!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm coming for you, boys! There's no escaping the long 'stache of the law!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: There! I got the back door open! Go go go! Get in there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You heard him! Run!
The guys file into the underground tunnel...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Max! Hurry up!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Actually... I'm not coming.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? What are you talking about?!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Officer Monte is going to bust into that office any second now. He'll catch us in no time... Unless someone stays back to hold him off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: No time for regrets, new fish! You three have lives to go back to... Girlfriends... Buddies... A future.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Me? I'm just a guy who's been in boot camp too long. Now go! Go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you so much, Max! We won't forget you! I'll tell Jacob you say 'hi!'

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Get running before I change my mind!
The three guys take off down the tunnel...
And emerge from a hole in the ground deep in the woods!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sacrificing himself so we could escape? That Max guy was something else...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He was a real friend...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, guys? Do you hear hound dogs barking?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They must be after us! Run! Into the woods! `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: They must be after us! Run! Into the woods! [i]Run![/i]

nodes.text: To Be Continued!
What'll happen next? Do the guys have what it takes to survive in the woods? Will they make it to Centerscore in time?
Find out on the next Surviving High School!
Brendan winds up and punches Hector in the face!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That... That kind of hurt!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You just crossed a line, son! I hope you've got insurance, because you're about to need it!
Hector dives forward, tackling Brendan...
And the two of them fly back into Howard!
All three guys fall to the ground and start fighting!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: There! I got the door, new fish! I'm out of here!
Max runs off, leaving the three guys grappling on the floor...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, well, well. What have we here? Looks like Bonnie, Clyde and Poindexter are having themselves a good ol' fashioned brouhaha...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Please, Officer Monte! We can explain!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh, you'll have all the time in the world to explain... When you're sitting pretty in Solitary Confinement!
A little while later, in a deep, dark pit on the far side of boot camp...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is it really solitary confinement if we're all down here together?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This is terrible! They can't keep us in a pit! This has got to be against some kind of law!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've got no right to complain! We wouldn't even be in this mess if you hadn't decided to go all Mixed Martial Arts on my face!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe I wouldn't have done that if you hadn't, you know, `ruined my entire life!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I wouldn't have done that if you hadn't, you know, [i]ruined my entire life![/i]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dogg, you are like a broken record! A really irritating broken record with a dumb, stupid face!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You want me to punch you again? I'll do it! I've fought way tougher bullies than you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Bring it on, little man! Let's see what you've got!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Would both of you just `shut up?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Would both of you just [i]shut up?![/i]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `NO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]NO![/i]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `NO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]NO![/i]

nodes.text: What a disaster! There's no way this is how the story is supposed to end!
Try again, and see if you can get a better ending! We know you can do it!
Or try playing our Premium Content Mega Pack, Love Potion Fun Pack!
Take personality quizzes, answer romantic trivia questions, and even play match-maker for some of your favorite Centerscore Students!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stop it, both of you! We can deal with this later! Right now, we've got to focus on escaping!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... But..

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Can't we just improvise?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, we can improvise, new fish... And then we'll get caught and thrown into solitary confinement! And I'm not going there! I'm not going back!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No, no, this was all my fault for ever dreaming... For ever having hope.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Max...
And so Max walks away, and with him goes any chance of the guys escaping...
The days soon pass and turn into weeks...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come on, boys! Those Peruvian pan-pipes aren't gonna play themselves!
And as the weeks turn into months, the boys find themselves... Changing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hurry up, you maggots! You two run like a couple of schoolgirls dipped in molasses!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You shut your mouth, Howard! If I wasn't out of breath, I'd beat you within an inch of your miserable life!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Would you two both quit your belly-aching and keep running? This is boot camp, not a French sewing circle!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Sniffle... Seeing you boys like this... How far you've come... It would bring a tear to my eye...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: If I hadn't lost my tear ducts in a knife fight at a debutante ball! Now keep running, you daffodils!
And soon enough, three months are up!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, boys, I don't normally let people out of here... But you three have done me proud! You're free to go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, Officer Monte, please don't make us go! We don't want to go back!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We've been here too long! The world's changed too much without us! We've become `institutionalized!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We've been here too long! The world's changed too much without us! We've become [i]institutionalized![/i]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now, now, boys, it's not that bad!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You don't know what it's like out there! People talk to each other without insults! Friends resolve conflicts without resorting to violence!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There are girls! `Girls!` It's terrifying!
nodes.text_bbcode: There are girls! [i]Girls![/i] It's terrifying!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You know what this sounds like? It sounds like pansy-talk! Real men aren't afraid of girls!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now you three turn around and get on that bus back to the real world, and you go show those ladies of yours what real men are like!
This is a disaster! All three guys are brain-washed, Max is locked away forever... And the Centerscore girls are in for one heck of a rude awakening!

nodes.text: The next few days pass at an agonizing crawl. Monte puts the boys through a variety of cruel tasks...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come on, boys! That floor isn't gonna scrub itself!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: My poor hands...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come on, boys! This field isn't gonna plow itself!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My poor shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come on, boys! This opera isn't gonna direct itself!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My poor dignity...
When there's a free minute, Max teaches the guys how to survive...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Now remember, if you're the first guy in line, you're not going to get much food because they're rationing it out...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And if I'm the last guy, there won't be any left! I've got to be in the middle!
He protects them from the aggressive locals...

nodes.speaker: Punk
nodes.text: Get outta my way, Max! This loser sucker-punched me when he was on the wrong side of town!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Yeah, well, he's under my protection now, so back off!
And he shares some of his boot camp wisdom!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Let me tell you something, my friend. Hope is a dangerous thing. Hope can drive a man insane.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are we still talking about girls?
And soon enough, a whole week has gone by! The boys have finished their latest task and have a free minute to rest...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm losing it, man! I can't take much more of this! I'm sore all over! Even my calluses have calluses!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Every night I have the same dream... My guild all dying without me... Their faces twisted in agony... Screaming 'Brendizzle... Brendizzle... We need more mana...'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just wish I knew if Linda had sent any letters...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Psst! Hey! New fish! Get your heads in the game!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: We're busting out of this joint... And we're doing it tonight!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're doing what when?!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Look, I've got an escape all planned out. I've been working on it for weeks! I needed three guys to help me out.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: I was hoping I'd have more time to toughen you up, but things are moving too fast! It's tonight or never! You in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stop it, both of you! We can deal with this later! Right now, we've got to focus on escaping!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... But..

Grab the keys! Be...
Stealthy!|Sneaky!
Noisy!|Clumsy!|Noisy!|Clumsy!
In the boot camp cafeteria, Brendan is mopping the floor, when...
There! The guard stepped out for a break! This is my chance!
Brendan jumps over the counter and heads into the kitchen.
Okay, I've got to move real fast! That guard's going to be back any second!
Now where the heck is that food...
Brendan walks towards the supply closet... When he steps on someone's hand!
Ow!
Aaaaaah! Floor goblin!
Oh wait, it's just you! What are you doing here?
In boot camp? Well, it turns out there's some stupid law against punching squirrels...
No, I meant, why are you hiding under an overturned table in the storage room?
I'm not hiding under it, I'm stuck! I was back here eating some extra food, and I tried to jump over this table to hide...
Next thing I know, it flips over, and I'm trapped! Now help me out, would you?
The thing is... I'm kind of in a hurry... The guard's going to come looking for me any minute!
What?! You're just going to abandon me? I've been here for two days!
Man, this sure is one lovely break I'm taking! Too bad it's going to end so soon...
Uh... Uh... Uh...
Make your choice!
Leave Skazz behind!|Let Skazz free!
Uh... Uh... Uh...
Really? You'll help me?
Hey, I couldn't just leave you trapped here! It'd be against the Paladin code!
Are those the things you eat at Indian restaurants?
Brendan bends down and flips the table over, freeing Skazz!
Awesome! Thanks, Brendan! You're an all-right guy!
No problem, Skazz. Now get out of here! I've got some food to steal!
When you do, make sure you grab the orange packets! They've got the good stuff!
Thanks for the heads up!
No! You can't leave me! I've never done anything bad to you!
Yes you did! You tried to beat me up when I got stranded on your side of town!
Oh, right. Well, no hard feelings then. See you around!
Sure...
Brendan runs into the storage closet... And finds a huge supply of sealed colored packets!
Whoa! They've got blue packets... Orange packets... Green packets... And red packets!
Which color should I take?
Make your choice!
Blue.|Orange.|Green.|Red.
Which color should I take?
Brendan grabs a packet and tries to open it to see what's in it, but...
Sigh... The breaks, they just go by too fast...
Yipes! Gotta move!
Brendan grabs a bunch of %s packets and rushes out, getting back to his mop just in time.
Later, as Brendan heads back to the meeting spot, he opens a packet and finds...
Awesome! These are full of protein bars, dried fruit, and trail mix!
This will be perfect! Now I just need to get to the rendezvous point...
What the...? These are full of cleaning supplies! We can't eat these!
I guess I really messed up... I hope the other guys are doing better!
What the? These are full of lead bars! Why would they keep these in the kitchen? Why would they keep these at all?
What the...? These are full of trash and compost! Ewwwww!
In the medical wing of the boot camp...
Ohhhh... I don't feel so good... I'm really going to need you to go get some medicine...
Really? You're sure you're `actually` sick?
Oh, yeah, for sho, I think it's swine flu. It feels `a lot` like swine flu.
Hmm. Interesting. Because to me, it feels `a lot` like you're faking to get out of your duties!
I am shocked and appalled that you would even think me capable of that! I'm seriously ill here, and you accuse me of lying?
Believe me, kid, I've seen a lot of fakers, and you've got 'faker' written all over you!
Cough... Cough... Feeling... Weak...
Yeah, yeah, blah, blah. What are your symptoms again?
Oh man, here goes nothing... Time to put my knowledge of medical trivia to the test!
Make your choice!
Which of these is `NOT` a symptom of the flu?
Chills.
Dilated pupils.
Severe coughing.
Muscle pains.
Shoot... I don't know if that was right...
That's gotta be right!
Make your choice!
Which of these is a real disease?
Sad Cow Disease.
Mad Sow Disease.
Rad Sow Disease.
Mad Cow Disease.
Hmm... Not sure that was right...
Yes! Nailed it!

The best way to avoid a cold is to...
Wear warm clothing.
Take vitamin C.
Regularly wash your hands.
Quickly bandage the wound.
Whoops, that was definitely wrong...
Oh yeah! Got that one right!

Wandering Eye Disorder.
Hysterical Pregnancy.
Funky Smell Syndrome.
Tubercollosus.
I don't think that was the right answer...
That had to be the right answer!
So your throat hurts, you've got a headache, you're feeling dizzy, and your left arm is completely numb?
Yes. Also, four of my teeth fell out, and I've got an uncontrollable craving for tapioca.
Oh my! That is an extremely serious medical condition! You're having a subneural fakeatoma!
Wait, what?
There's only way to fix this! You need an immediate injection of liquid nitrogen directly into your eyeball! It's the only way to reach the brain in time!
The nurse pulls out a gigantic syringe and starts approaching Hector!
Wait! Stop! This is all a horrible misunderstanding!
Now, now, don't struggle... They say this hurts just a tiny bit more than childbirth...
No! Please! I was faking! Don't stab me in the eye! I was just faking, I swear!
Yeah. That's what I figured. Idiot.
Now get out of here before I report you to Officer Monte!
Geez, I really messed this up! I hope the other guys are doing a better job...
Oh my! I'm sorry I accused you of faking... It sounds like you're really ill!
So... So weak... I can see the light... At the end of the tunnel...
This is a serious medical emergency! I've got to go to get my textbooks!
The nurse runs off.
Finally! I thought she'd never leave!
Here's the file cabinet... Here's the 'Spare Supplies' drawer... And here are the IDs! Nice!
Hector grabs four IDs and shoves them quickly in his pockets!
I'm back! And according to this, you've only got four hours left to live!
Oh, uh, actually, I'm fine now. Turns out it, uh, was just some indigestion... Boot camp gumbo, am I right?
Well... The gumbo is pretty nasty...
Exactly! Now if you'll excuse me, I've got some manual labor to get back to!

Down by the lake...
All right, boy, listen here. I've got myself a date tonight with one very foxy lady that I met through that weird electronic talking box in my office...
Your computer?
Yeah, yeah, my demon-box. The point is, this may be my first date since the Reagan administration, but that doesn't mean I've lost my mojo!
If I know anything about women, it's that they like two things... Moustaches and musk! I've got the first one covered, but I'm going to need your help with the other...
Uh oh...
Luckily, I happen to know the recipe for the perfect cologne! Monte's Manly Musk of Maximum Machoness!
I'm going to wade into the lake and try to grab myself a handful of crawdads... You go search the woods and see if you can find a hedgehog for us to milk!
Monte hunkers over by the river and starts trying to grab crawdads. His keys hang visibly on his belt.
This is my chance! I just have to sneak over and grab them...
Okay... Nice and sneaky... Nice and sneaky...
Howard reaches forward to grab the keys...
But slips and falls forward, grabbing Monte's belt instead!
What in tarnation are you up to?!
Uh, sorry, sir! I'm up to, uh, nothing, sir!
Your lies don't work on me, son! I know you were trying to steal my belt!
No, I... Wait, what?
Drop the innocent act! You and I both know this fancy belt is 100% pure Dominican weasel-fur! Made from the chest and belly hair of real Dominican weasels!
I really wish I didn't know that...
Now quit lollygagging and go fetch me that hedgehog! I've got some slippery little crawdads to catch...
I guess I really failed this one... Let's hope the other guys have better luck!
Howard leans in...
Almost there... Almost there... Stay on target...
Got 'em! Yes!
Howard pockets the keys and quickly steps back...
You! Chuckles! Did you find me that hedgehog?!
Uh, no, sir! I chased after one, but it, uh, ran away!
You telling me you don't even know how to build a hedgehog snare?! What are they teaching you in school, anyway? Let me show you how it's done...

When we last left off, Brendan, Hector, and Howard were arrested for burning down the Wilson High library!
After an unusually speedy trial...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But we're innocent!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Yeah, and I'm the King of Canada! I find you guilty!
The boys are sentenced... To three months at `Officer Monte's Boot Camp For Troubled Boys!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The boys are sentenced... To three months at [b]Officer Monte's Boot Camp For Troubled Boys![/b]

nodes.text: Deep in the cold, damp Centerscore woods, the three boys stand in front of a huge, locked compound...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Man, this `sucks.` My parents are furious! Even my sisters think I went too far!
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, this [i]sucks.[/i] My parents are furious! Even my sisters think I went too far!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This is a disaster! I'm going to fall behind in all my classes! I'm not going to get into a good college! I'm going to miss, like, fifteen raids!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Um... Is someone supposed to meet us here?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Shut up, Hector! This is all your fault! I never even wanted to be a part of your stupid prank war! You tricked me into doing it, and now you've ruined my life!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know, you're right. This totally is my fault. I am so sorry I set up an elaborate ruse to frame you for setting off fireworks that burned down Wilson's library.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh wait, that wasn't me, that was Alexei! So drop the pity party, dogg! We all got played! We're all victims!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh please, Hector! Don't even try the innocent victim act! We all know you went back to Wilson and started the fire!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I didn't do that! I swear! For realsies!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Then why didn't you have an alibi? Why did you borrow those fireworks from Howard? And why did that traffic camera catch you on the Wilson side of town?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because I... It's because I... I... I was...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I just can't tell you guys, okay? It's a secret!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, it's no secret! You went too far, and now we're all paying the price... And you can't even own up to it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, I can own up to it... This just isn't any of your business! Now back off, or you'll be owning up to a big, black eye!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Both of you! Listen up!

options.label: Hector, you need to tell us the truth.
Brendan, you need to back off.

nodes.text: Because I... It's because I... I... I was...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I just can't tell you guys, okay? It's a secret!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, it's no secret! You went too far, and now we're all paying the price... And you can't even own up to it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, I can own up to it... This just isn't any of your business! Now back off, or you'll be owning up to a big, black eye!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Both of you! Listen up!

options.label: Hector, you need to tell us the truth.
Brendan, you need to back off.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I got us the IDs!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I managed to get the food!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You can call me the Pianoman, because I'm rocking some keys!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Perfect! I knew I could count on you three! Now let's go get into position...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: We're just going to have to break a window to get into the admin building... And that means we're going to have a lot less time.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Well, two out of three ain't great...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: You three still in?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You better believe it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure thing.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...I suppose so...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Then let's go get into position!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: But it's your lucky day! I got my hands on these paperclips, and I'm pretty sure I'll be able to pick the locks!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: I've managed to save away a couple of bags of trail mix. We're just going to have to make it in the woods with that!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: No no no! We can't escape with just the IDs!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Well, this isn't going to work at all! We can't escape with nothing but food!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: This isn't good, guys! We can't escape without food or IDs!
There's only one thing more difficult than escaping from boot camp... And that's playing a perfect game! Amazing!
Enjoy your bonus scene, you dangerous, dashing fugitive!
Back in camp, Monte has Max pinned against the wall...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You've racked up quite the record for yourself! Fraud! Jail-break! Reckless endangerment of security officers! Unauthorized domestication of a bear!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: If I didn't know better, I'd think you were `trying` to get more time added to your sentence!
nodes.text_bbcode: If I didn't know better, I'd think you were [i]trying[/i] to get more time added to your sentence!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Maybe I just can't handle the thought of being away from you.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Add 'hurting an officer's feelings' to that list! Guards! Take Dillinger here to Solitary Confinement!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I've got me some fugitives to track...
The guards drop Max off in a deep, dark pit. He waits patiently until they're gone...
Then gropes around in the dark until he finds a tunnel entrance!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: It took me seventeen trips to Solitary to dig this thing... And because it's so dark, the guards never noticed it!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: I could never escape before though, because Monte was checking on me every half hour... But now he'll be chasing those boys down for at least two days!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Looks like my plan went off without a hitch! By the time he gets back to check on me, I'll be halfway to Vegas!

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: I do hope those new fish make it to Centerscore okay...

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: Ah, I'm sure they'll be fine! They seem like some pretty capable fellas, and I'm sure they'll work something out.

nodes.speaker: Max
nodes.text: So long, new fish. Here's to us and the ultimate boot camp breakout!
Max takes one final look up and then vanishes into the tunnel!
So there you have it! Even Max made it out all right... And believe us, Officer Monte is going to be mad when he finds out!
Check in next episode, and see how our new fish do braving the great outdoors!
Congratulations again on a perfect episode! See you next time!
